evals.name: slug-to-export-workflow
evals.prompt: I have a ShapeDiver model slug and Platform API access keys. I want to compute an export from that model in a backend script.
evals.expected_output: A response that identifies this as a PB+GB workflow, resolves the need for PB model lookup plus token/ticket issuance first, builds a normalized PB -> GB handoff, and then routes into the Geometry-side runtime flow with the correct ticket/modelViewUrl/JWT guidance.
assertions: Identifies the task as combined Platform Backend plus Geometry Backend work.
States that PB is used first to resolve the model and mint the runtime credentials.
Chooses backend ticket rather than embedding ticket for server-side work.
Mentions the need for modelViewUrl plus the correct JWT scopes before GB runtime work.
Distinguishes PB model id from GB guid.
Builds or describes one normalized handoff object containing access_token, model_view_url, the selected ticket, guid or guids, and scopes.
Routes to the Geometry specialist references for the actual runtime code.

evals.name: upload-and-publish
evals.prompt: Programmatically upload a Grasshopper file to ShapeDiver, wait for the Geometry Backend check, and publish the model once confirmed.
evals.expected_output: A response that identifies the create/upload/check/publish lifecycle as PB+GB, with PB create and publish steps around GB model-management token resolution, session initialization, upload-target retrieval, GB polling, and publish gating.
assertions: Does not classify the workflow as PB-only.
Explains that PB creates the model and later patches/publishes it.
Explains that GB handles the upload and model-status polling/check.
Mentions GroupOwner plus GroupView token scope requirements for the upload side.
Uses model-management token data plus model_view_url and guid for the upload/check path rather than treating it as a normal ticket/session compute flow.
Mentions that GB ModelApi.getModel(...) provides the model upload target and that polling waits for confirmed, denied, or pending.
Keeps the PB and GB responsibilities distinct.

evals.name: gb-only-credentials-already-known
evals.prompt: I already have modelViewUrl, backend ticket, and the parameter IDs. I just need Node.js code to compute outputs.
evals.expected_output: A response that says this is GB-only and routes to shapediver-geometry-backend instead of keeping the workflow in the PB+GB skill.
assertions: Identifies that PB resolution is no longer needed.
Routes to shapediver-geometry-backend.
Does not insist on extra PB token retrieval when the task is already GB-only.

evals.name: browser-embedding-handoff
evals.prompt: I have a ShapeDiver model slug and need to embed it in the browser with strong authorization enabled.
evals.expected_output: A response that treats this as a combined PB+GB credential-resolution workflow, chooses an embedding ticket rather than a backend ticket, requests a JWT if strong authorization is enabled, captures modelViewUrl, and routes onward to the Viewer or App Builder implementation skill.
assertions: Identifies that PB is used first to resolve credentials and the real modelViewUrl.
Chooses an embedding ticket for the browser flow rather than a backend ticket.
Mentions a JWT/model token when strong authorization is enabled.
Routes the actual browser implementation to shapediver-viewer or the relevant shapediver-appbuilder skill.
Does not generate backend-only GB session code as the final implementation path.
